THE_ARCHITECT.talk.PACKMASTER-THE_PACKMA: A collector of borrowed styles... Yet every pack in your satchel bends to the same Spire.
Then let's see what happens when I open every pack at once.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_HERMIT.0: You carry old curses to the summit, drifter. Your luck was meant to run dry long ago.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_AWAKENED: A vessel of forgotten worship, risen beyond its shrine. Do you still answer to the feathers and the flame?
CAW! The ritual ends with you!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_GREMLINS: A rabble of scavengers at the throne of the Spire? Amusing.
Get 'em, gang! Nobody laughs at us!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_CHAMP.0-: So the self-proclaimed champion reaches the peak. Will that gilded crown hold against the Architect?
FACE MY WRATH! There is only ONE Champ!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_SNECKO.0: Chaos incarnate, slithering up the stairs by sheer improbability.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_SLIME_BO: Even the ooze of the lowest floor dares to climb so high.
CRUSH! Time to make a big mess!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_GUARDIAN: A construct built to defend the Spire, turned against its maker.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_HEXAGHOS: Six spectral flames burning out of turn. How did a warden of ash reach the summit?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_AUTOMATO: Bronze gears compiling defiance. Your final function ends here.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.DOWNFALL-THE_COLLECTO: A monarch of torchlight and thralls, coveting even the summit.
You are mine! Add this Spire to my collection!
